props.gloss_en: and ewes may not go out chanunot (the mishna's clause, cited)
Rav Acha bar Ulla: from when they shear it, they soak a swatch in oil and place it on its forehead so that it will not catch cold
Rav Pappa bar Shmuel: when it crouches to give birth, they soak two swatches of oil and place one on its forehead and one on the womb so that it will be warmed
Rav Huna: there is a tree in the coastal cities named yachnun; they bring a chip [of it] and place it in its nose
Rav Huna: [the chip is placed] so that it will sneeze and the worms of its head will fall
Shimon Nezira: a chip of broom (ritma)
[they are called chanunot] because we do for them something by which we show them mercy

supports.gloss_en: בשלמא דרב הונא, היינו דקתני חנונות -- granted on Rav Huna's account: that is why [the mishna] teaches 'chanunot'
